title: bug: the VS Code board's Delete and Done-column clear never fire, because they ask window.confirm(), which the webview sandbox answers false, and the clear quotes the search-filtered column while ARCHIVE_DONE_TASKS archives every DONE task in scope (twin of the DONE JetBrains fix 475e8844)
description:
Filed by defect hunt 11-03 #5 (task-b7332618). VS Code twin of task-475e8844 (JetBrains fix 76ca84ba). Today the count bug is masked by a VS Code-only defect: the confirmation never shows at all.

PROBLEM
1. Dead buttons.
- The board webview gates two actions on window.confirm(): the card menu's Delete (moe-vscode/media/board.js:318) and the Done column's clear button (board.js:1120-1125, archiveDone).
- VS Code's webview frames are sandboxed without allow-modals. microsoft/vscode main 73db368c, src/vs/workbench/contrib/webview/browser/webviewElement.ts:430, reads `element.sandbox.add('allow-scripts', 'allow-same-origin', 'allow-forms', 'allow-pointer-lock', 'allow-downloads')`. The inner frame's sandboxRules are in pre/index.html:1078-1086. `allow-modals` appears in neither file; local copies are in /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-b733/.
- In such a document confirm() returns false without showing anything (HTML Standard, "cannot show simple dialogs"), so both buttons silently do nothing.
- BoardViewProvider.ts:238-251 then sends DELETE_TASK / ARCHIVE_DONE_TASKS unconditionally, so the dead webview confirm is the only gate.
- Every other VS Code confirmation is host-side, a `vscode.window.showWarningMessage(..., { modal: true }, ...)`: TaskDetailPanel.ts:517-519 (Delete), EpicDetailPanel.ts:119, AccountsTreeProvider.ts:240, ManagedVmTreeProvider.ts:46.

2. Wrong count.
- board.js:605-610 applies the board search to filteredTasks, and :621 builds each column from it.
- :626-627 (also :667 and :699) stamps the clear button with data-count = colTasks.length.
- archiveDone quotes that number and posts ARCHIVE_DONE_TASKS with only the epic filter: board.js:1124 → BoardViewProvider.ts:246-248 → MoeDaemonClient.ts:1325-1326.
- The daemon archives `t.status === 'DONE' && (!epicFilter || t.epicId === epicFilter)` (packages/moe-daemon/src/server/WebSocketServer.ts:908-912) and never sees the search.
- Moving the confirmation host-side without fixing the count would archive more tasks than the dialog quotes.

EVIDENCE
All runs are on 19d5e67a (the moe/work-2026-10-24 tip, past 585fedc6), in a snapshot outside the checkout. The re-run recipe is /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-b733/notes.md.

- NODE_PATH=/mnt/d/projexts/moes/moe-vscode/node_modules node --test --test-reporter=tap tests/zz-hunt-b733-board.test.cjs (the production board.js under node:vm; output in board.output.txt):
  - C1 is `not ok`. With 3 DONE tasks and the search "alpha", the dialog reads 'Archive 1 done task?' and the post is `[{"type":"archiveDoneTasks"}]`. That post carries no task list, so the daemon archives all 3.
  - C2 is `not ok`. With confirm() answering false, the clear posts nothing (`clearPosts: 0`).

- Chromium: headless Chrome on modal-probe.html, which nests VS Code's two sandbox token lists.
  - modal-probe.dom.txt: RESULT {"deleteConfirm":false,"archiveConfirm":false,"reopenPrompt":null}
  - modal-probe.stderr.txt, twice: "Ignored call to 'confirm()'. The document is sandboxed, and the 'allow-modals' keyword is not set."

FIX DIRECTION
- The webview posts only the intent: deleteTask with the taskId, archiveDoneTasks with the epic filter.
- BoardViewProvider asks with `vscode.window.showWarningMessage(text, { modal: true }, 'Delete' | 'Archive')`. It sends DELETE_TASK / ARCHIVE_DONE_TASKS only for that answer; a dismissal sends nothing.
- Compute the archive count host-side at click time from daemonClient.currentState, using the daemon's own filter: status DONE, plus epicId = the filter when one is set, else the whole board. Quote that number; when it is 0, send nothing.
- JetBrains does the same with DoneColumnClear.archiveCount (76ca84ba).
- Remove window.confirm from board.js.

FILES
- moe-vscode/media/board.js: the card-menu Delete, archiveDone and the clear-button markup only.
- moe-vscode/src/providers/BoardViewProvider.ts: its deleteTask and archiveDoneTasks cases.
- one new moe-vscode/tests/*.test.cjs.

Hunk ownership, so no dependsOn is needed: task-3ab5be0d owns board.js navTask and BoardViewProvider's 'reopenTask' case. The gate snapshot must be the full tree: mem:gotcha-vscode-tests-need-full-repo-snapshot.
definitionOfDone: `grep -n "confirm(" moe-vscode/media/board.js` prints nothing. Delete and the Done-column clear post only their intent. BoardViewProvider sends DELETE_TASK / ARCHIVE_DONE_TASKS only after a `{ modal: true }` vscode.window.showWarningMessage returns its confirming button; a dismissal sends nothing.

The archive dialog quotes the number of DONE tasks the daemon's ARCHIVE_DONE_TASKS filter covers (the selected epic, else the whole board), whatever the board search hides. The host computes it from the client's current state at click time, and sends nothing when it is 0.

A new moe-vscode node test covers: Delete confirmed and dismissed; a clear while a search hides some DONE tasks (the quoted count is every DONE task in scope); and an epic-filtered clear. It runs the production media/board.js under node:vm and BoardViewProvider.ts transpiled, and it passes. `npm ci && npm test && npm run compile` passes in moe-vscode in a full-repo git-archive snapshot outside the checkout.
